Effectiveness conditions are stated outright for this credit in the President's report (paras 52, 54, 56), so kept. The other two items come only from the draft Development Credit Agreement and draft Madhya Pradesh Agreement as summarized in that report (paras 41, 48); reworded to 'draft agreements ... provided' so they are not presented as signed terms. Safeguard tag kept on that draft covenant; owner may prefer to drop it.
All items found in ESRS/ESAP 38831. Split road and power-line items: the road review is to limit biodiversity and aquatic impacts; the power-line review is to keep to the existing right of way.

Read both agreements (OCR text). Art. 5.01 (Fund money only for goods for the agreed works), 5.02(b) (no money for non-member countries except New Zealand and Switzerland), 7.01(b) (international competition unless the Administrator agrees otherwise) and 1964 Art. 4.01(a) (Fund applied first to the Jhelum dam) all confirmed. These are not generic Bank rules: they are the terms of the Fund that paid for Mangla. Empty ct is correct, since open international procurement is not tied procurement and no other listed type fits.

Financing Agreement Sched. 2 Sec. E (ESS, ESCP, funds, staff, no amendment without IDA) and PAD para 73 (ESMP for Santa Cruz runway works within six months of effectiveness, in the ESCP) confirmed.

Effectiveness conditions (para 18) are stated as such and kept as conditions. Para 15-17 items are described in the report as 'agreed' (in negotiations, or in TANESCO's agreed implementation program), and the text says 'agreed', not 'required', so the priv and safeguard tags rest on agreed terms of this credit; acceptable under the brief. Small fixes: tariff rise runs until the tariff study is carried out; hiring freeze and mitigation plan come from the agreed implementation program, not the negotiation list.
Loan Agreement 7432-TUN Sched. 2 paras 3-4 and Additional Event of Suspension (ANGed decree) confirmed.

The soil-study and forest-survey item is a stated condition of disbursement for the credit component, so 'had to be finished' is correct. Both tags supported.

Flow-study conditions and 4 June 2011 IFC confirmation confirmed (paras 39-40, 118, timeline). Removed 'IFC included' (the report says 'all Lenders'). Dropped the written-notice sentence: it comes from the IDB environmental report saying the Bank 'will require' it in the loan agreement, which is a stated intention, not a confirmed term.

CAO report: RPF a condition of IFC Board approval; full PRCV a condition of disbursement in legal agreements; lenders required BAP with net gain and aquatic offset; loan agreements referenced PS5. All confirmed.

PAD data sheet confirms all effectiveness conditions and covenants quoted (FCFA 8bn/15.7bn, landfill operator contract, concession agreement, Mbeubeuss closure by 30 Nov 2010, no resettlement before closure, written confirmation before Phase 3/4). IFC ESRS 29008 confirms it 'has not required SENAC to prepare a separate evaluation'.

IFC SPI 26590 sets fund-level duties for CAMIF (upgrade its management system before disbursement; keep IFC-supported investments in line with IFC standards). It never names Hidro Sala or Genhidro, and CAMIF bought into Genhidro in 2012, years after the 2008 IFC loan. Under the brief, fund-level terms count only when the source ties them to this project, so blanked.

ESRS/ESAP 34846 confirms Soy Moratorium procedures, anonymous grievance channel incl. contractors, security risk assessment, armed guards/public security policies under PS4, and disposal-site checks; investment is equity.

Dropped the EAIF fund-level sentence: IFC SPI 27313 sets duties for the fund as a whole and does not name Addax. Kept the SEI sentence, which ties the RAP requirement and annual independent monitor to the Makeni project's lenders (SEI p. on land lease and RAPs; 'at the DFIs' behest' for the monitor).

IFC SPI 29145 sets bank-level duties for Ecobank (revise its management system; have subsidiaries receiving IFC money adopt it) and does not mention Olam. IDI's line that Ecobank 'was required to ensure that the projects it finances comply' is IDI's reading of the same bank-level terms, not a term of the 2012 Olam loan. No source ties these to the Olam money, so blanked.

PAD data sheet and footnote 26 confirm all IDA items; 'water fee law' changed to 'water tariff legislation' (the PAD's term; it was a decree). EIB report paras 5.18-5.20 (in French): prior approval covers the two ESMPs and the resettlement plan (PIR), not the action plan, so wording narrowed.

Items confirmed (Table 2, timeline, section on assessment). Report does not say EBRD and IFC jointly 'agreed' the ESAP with the company in those words, so removed that attribution. The waiver finding is labelled 'preliminary evidence' by IPAM; wording now says so.
